tools.name: run_aeo_report
tools.description: Run the free AI-visibility report for a website (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude coverage, competitor gaps, prioritized fixes). Requires the user's real email — the finished report is emailed there and a shareable report URL is returned. Takes up to ~10 minutes; set wait_seconds up to 50 to wait

tools.name: get_aeo_report_status
tools.description: Poll a previously submitted AEO report job once. status is queued, preparing, needs_review or running (keep polling) or complete, partial or failed (terminal); state carries the phase and reason. When complete or partial, returns the structured report (per-engine breakdown with provenance, recommend

tools.name: site_audit_start
tools.description: Start a site audit for one public page. Returns audit_id; poll it with site_audit_get. Requires an agency key (the same key as run_aeo_report). The same Idempotency-Key replays the same audit. A prospect audit starts an AI visibility report owned by that requesting key unless include_visibility is f

tools.name: site_audit_get
tools.description: Read a site audit started with site_audit_start. format json (the default) returns the status and the report JSON. format md returns the Markdown report. Requires the same agency key. Fails closed when the audit API is turned off.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool removed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "site_audit_start" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
